passages.provision_quote: Use agency or department moneys or personnel to investigate, interrogate, detain, detect, or arrest persons for immigration enforcement purposes
passages.note: The chaptered text limits state and local cooperation with federal immigration enforcement; it sets no rule about who is removed.

rows.reasoning: The only record is her Aye on SB 54 (2017-2018), the California Values Act, whose operative sections bar California law enforcement agencies from using “agency or department moneys or personnel to investigate, interrogate, detain, detect, or arrest persons for immigration enforcement purposes”. That limits state and local cooperation with federal enforcement; it does not say whether the government should remove no one, only those “convicted of serious violent crimes”, recent arrivals, or everyone. Per the annex hard case on cooperation with federal enforcement, the passage is adjacent and the row is BLANK no-evidence rather than direction-only.
